### OysterVisitor

```ts

  actor: Readonly<{
    kind: "visitor";

}>;
```

### InstanceResult

```ts
type InstanceResult<T> =
  | Readonly<{
      ok: true;
      value: T;
    }>
  | Readonly<{
      ok: false;
      code: AppInstanceErrorCode | "failed";
      causeClass?:
        | "Error"
        | "TypeError"
        | "RangeError"
        | "SyntaxError"
        | "AbortError"
        | "TimeoutError"
        | "Other";
    }>;
```

### ArtifactStore

```ts
type ArtifactStore = Readonly<{
  get: (artifactRef) => Promise<Uint8Array | null>;
  put: (artifactRef, bytes) => Promise<void>;
}>;
```

Immutable Release bytes addressed by their artifact reference.

### VerifiedRelease

```ts
type VerifiedRelease = Readonly<{
  release: Release;
  build: AppBuild;
  api: AppApi | null;
  declaration: AppDeclaration | null;
  ui:
    | Readonly<{
        kind: "html";
        artifactRef: ArtifactRef;
        digest: Sha256Digest;
      }>
    | Readonly<{
        kind: "assets";
        build: AssetBuild;
      }>
    | null;
  backend: Readonly<{
    artifactRef: ArtifactRef;
    digest: Sha256Digest;
  }> | null;
}>;
```

A Release whose root, UI and backend artifacts were read and verified.

### createOyster()

```ts
function createOyster(host): Hono<OysterEnv>;
```

Create the Oyster App server: a Hono app that installs App Releases, serves
their UI, forwards their backend requests and methods to their Instances, and
mounts the host's MCP endpoint. The host's adapters decide where state lives and
who may sign in.

#### Parameters

| Parameter | Type                        |
| --------- | --------------------------- |
| `host`    | [`OysterHost`](#oysterhost) |

#### Returns

`Hono`\<[`OysterEnv`](#oysterenv)\>

Read a Release root and verify its UI build and backend descriptor. `readAssets`
verifies UI object bodies when true. When false, it reads the asset manifest
needed to resolve references but does not read any UI object body, including
standalone HTML.

#### Parameters

| Parameter                 | Type                                                                                                               | Default value        | Description                                                          |
| ------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | -------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `store`                   | [`ArtifactStore`](#artifactstore)                                                                                  | `undefined`          | -                                                                    |
| `release`                 | `Release`                                                                                                          | `undefined`          | -                                                                    |
| `policy`                  | \{ `maxManifestBytes`: `number`; `maxObjects`: `number`; `maxObjectBytes`: `number`; `maxTotalBytes`: `number`; \} | `defaultAssetPolicy` | -                                                                    |
| `policy.maxManifestBytes` | `number`                                                                                                           | `undefined`          | -                                                                    |
| `policy.maxObjects`       | `number`                                                                                                           | `undefined`          | -                                                                    |
| `policy.maxObjectBytes`   | `number`                                                                                                           | `undefined`          | -                                                                    |
| `policy.maxTotalBytes`    | `number`                                                                                                           | `undefined`          | -                                                                    |
| `readAssets`              | `boolean`                                                                                                          | `true`               | Read and check every UI object now. Serving verifies each on demand. |

Resolve a Release to its verified durable backend without reading its UI: the
root artifact, then the backend descriptor it names.

| `release` | `Release`                         |
